jd_text: Purpose of Position As an Oracle Fusion / OIC Developer, you will design, develop, deploy, and support Oracle Integration Cloud integrations, technical extensions, and enterprise reporting solutions, combining hands-on development with technical leadership across on-prem, SaaS and PaaS applications and establishing continuous delivery and integration. Essential Functions Integration Development Design, develop, test, deploy, and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Build inbound, outbound, real-time, scheduled, batch, event-driven, and API-based integrations between Oracle Fusion Cloud and third-party / external applications . Utilize Oracle Fusion REST APIs, SOAP services , PVOs, FBDI, UCM, ESS Jobs, OIC adapters, and event-driven architectures. Design reusable, scalable integration frameworks following Oracle best practices and enterprise integration patterns, with API governance. Load data conversions through the FBDI process and write specifications for conversions, integrations, modifications, and reports. Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, and autorecovery frameworks; optimize performance, scalability, and security. Technical Extensions and Platform Develop Oracle Fusion technical extensions using Oracle PaaS services , OCI , Oracle Visual Builder (VBCS) , and Oracle Autonomous Database (ATP). Administer and support different Oracle Cloud environments. Reporting and Data Design and maintain Fusion reports using BI Publisher (incl. report bursting), OTBI, BICC, Oracle Fusion Analytics, and SQL. Develop BIP data models using PVOs and SQL; create XML templates; build dashboards, KPIs, operational reports, scheduling/distribution. Create and optimize SQL and PL/SQL against PVOs/VOs; ensure data accuracy and optimize report/query performance. Security and Compliance Build secure integrations and APIs using OAuth 2.0, JWT, and API Gateway. Collaborate with the Information Security Architect and IT Compliance team on data privacy and security for cloud environments. Support, Testing and Leadership Provide L1/L2/L3 support; troubleshoot failures and coordinate resolutions with Oracle Support. Support Oracle quarterly updates by analyzing impacts, testing changes, and implementing enhancements. Develop unit test scripts and coordinate SIT/UAT with users and business analysts. Support production deployments, hypercare, and ongoing production support. Lead technical design sessions, perform code reviews, estimate effort, and mentor junior developers. Collaborate with DevOps teams on Git-based source control and CI/CD processes. Produce technical design, deployment guides, and operational documentation. Education, Background and Skill Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field. 5+ years supporting Oracle Fusion integrations/reports; 5+ years hands-on OIC; 5+ years Oracle ERP/Fusion technical development preferred. Experience delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation or upgrade projects across multiple enterprise projects. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and performance-tuning skills. Excellent verbal and written communication; collaborative across functional borders. SDLC, requirement elicitation, documentation, test scripts; data management; Knowledge of Fusion Cloud modules. Certifications Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Certification - Preferred. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Certification - Preferred; other Fusion certifications preferred. title: Product Owner
jd_text: BSN SPORTS, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE RECOGNIZED LEADER IN TEAM ATHLETIC GEAR For over 50 years, BSN SPORTS has been the largest team sporting goods equipment and apparel distributor of choice in the United States . Our 3,000 BSN SPORTS employees strive to support the Heart of the Game by putting valuable time back into the day of coaches and administrators through excellent service platforms. Our company mission is simple: Save coaches and administrators time with everything they do off the field so they have more time to impact young lives on it. LOCATION: Onsite 4 days per week at Farmers Branch TX Varsity Brands HQ HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: The Product Owner supports and progressively expands ownership of the overall digital experience, product needs, and continuous-improvement priorities for one of BSN SPORTS' primary business channels: Club, Collegiate, or Institutional. This role serves as a primary product representative for the assigned channel, partnering with business stakeholders, executive leadership, Commercial teams, customers, frontline employees, and application-aligned Portfolio Product Owners. The position will identify opportunities, evaluate customer and business needs, contribute to prioritization decisions, and translate channel objectives into coordinated product initiatives across BSN SPORTS' digital platforms. Portfolio Product Owners are aligned to applications and platforms including BSNSports.com, My Team Shop, Sideline Stores, and Team Art Locker. The Product Owner will partner with the appropriate Portfolio Product Owners and senior Product Owners to ensure channel needs are understood, prioritized, and delivered through the relevant application roadmaps. Unresolved conflicts will be elevated to the executive steering committee for final direction. This role develops a strong understanding of how customer value, business priorities, and technical feasibility influence product decisions across the assigned channel. The Product Owner will support and contribute to product initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption. They will remain actively engaged in discovery, requirements, prioritization, testing, release readiness, and post-launch adoption, while maintaining lighter involvement during active software development and continuing to build expertise in product ownership, Agile delivery practices, customer discovery, and data-informed decision making. In addition to major initiatives, the role will maintain and prioritize a continuous backlog of smaller enhancements, customer pain points, defects, technical improvements, and operational-efficiency opportunities while developing the judgment and product management skills needed to independently own increasingly complex products and initiatives over time. Commercial teams retain accountability for revenue and business results. The Product Owner focuses on customer experience, product outcomes, adoption, usability, operational effectiveness, and translating channel needs into technology-enabled solutions. Working under the guidance of more senior Product Owners, this role develops the knowledge, judgment, and product management capabilities necessary to progressively assume greater ownership of product strategy, prioritization, customer outcomes, and product performance. title: Financial Business Intelligence Manager
jd_text: When you’re the best, we’re the best. Summary: In this role, you will lead the design and development of advanced finance analytics, business intelligence, and reporting solutions that support corporate targets and informed decision-making. You will independently build complex Power BI dashboards and data visualizations from the ground up, source and model data from Databricks and other data sources, and translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insights. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Data Analytics, and Business Intelligence. The ideal candidate brings strong financial acumen together with hands-on technical expertise in Power BI development, data modeling, visualization design, and analytics solution delivery. Your work will support senior executives, the Finance Committee, the Board of Directors, investors, and internal business partners. Responsibilities: Independently design, build, test, deploy, and maintain complex Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualization solutions from the ground up. Develop scalable Power BI solutions using advanced features such as data models, calculated measures, interactive slicers, drill-through functionality, and row-level security. Source, transform, model, and validate data from Databricks and other enterprise data sources to support finance reporting and analytics needs. Translate complex financial and operational data into intuitive visualizations, management insights, and executive-level financial narratives. Partner with Finance leaders and business stakeholders to gather requirements, define key performance indicators, and convert business needs into effective analytics solutions. Produce monthly and quarterly consolidated reporting and dashboards for senior executives, the Finance Committee, the Board of Directors, investors, and internal partners. Perform data reconciliation, validation, and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy and integrity of dashboards, reports, calculations, and underlying data. Collaborate with Accounting, Financial Systems, and technical partners to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve source-data, logic, integration, and reporting issues. Support FP&A team members with business-unit reporting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and performance insights. Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, improve dashboard performance, streamline analytics processes, and strengthen self-service reporting capabilities. Qualifications: Relevant degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. Advanced degree desired. Five or more years of experience in finance analytics, financial business intelligence, FP&A reporting, data visualization, or a related area. Demonstrated experience independently designing and building complex Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions from initial requirements through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Advanced hands-on Power BI development experience, including data modeling, DAX calculations, interactive visualizations, slicers, drill-through functionality, and row-level security. Experience sourcing, transforming, validating, and modeling data from Databricks or a comparable cloud-based enterprise data platform. Strong understanding of financial reporting, FP&A processes, financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, key performance indicators, and business-performance analysis. Experience translating financial and business requirements into scalable analytics, reporting, and visualization solutions. Ability to analyze complex data, recognize trends and anomalies, and communicate clear, actionable recommendations to business and executive audiences. Experience troubleshooting data-quality, reporting-logic, calculation, and source-system issues in partnership with finance and technical teams. Strong attention to detail with a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, integrity, documentation, and quality assurance. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex financial and technical information to senior-level stakeholders. Role Summary The Financial Analyst, FP&A supports close, actuals, and planning activities for Worldwide Operations, with a focus on Manufacturing, Logistics, and Supply Chain. The role partners across the Finance organization and with WMO Operations and SPG Finance. It turns operational and financial data into clear, actionable insights. The analyst works with stakeholders at all levels, from frontline operations teams to senior Finance and executive leadership. They own key recurring deliverables and help improve how the organization reports and analyzes performance. Key Responsibilities Close, Consolidation & Actuals Own the WMO consolidation for total Cost of Sales (COS), including absorption, allocations, and related reconciliations, so results are accurate and on time each period. Run monthly and quarterly close activities on recurring tasks with minimal oversight, investigating and resolving variances and data issues as they come up. Analyze actuals against plan, forecast, and prior periods, identifying the operational drivers behind cost and absorption movements. Planning & Forecasting Support the annual operating plan (AOP/Pre-AOP) and quarterly forecast cycles for Manufacturing, Logistics, and Supply Chain, including spend, labor, capital, and volume-driven assumptions. Track and quantify P&L opportunities and risks (e.g., timing shifts, tariffs, reserve releases, completion risk), keeping leadership informed of the outlook and changes to it. Partner with Operations and SPG Finance to validate assumptions and keep forecasts consistent with business and fab/customer timing. Reporting & Executive Communication Prepare quarterly financial reporting packages for senior Finance and executive leadership, including clear actuals-vs-plan variance commentary. Build dashboards and executive-ready presentations that explain complex financial information clearly and concisely. Present findings to stakeholders across Finance and Operations, at times acting as a direct business partner to non-finance management. Process Improvement & Systems Lead efforts to streamline management reporting and to centralize data, reporting, and analytics into a reliable single source of truth. Serve as a key participant, or lead, on system integration and process improvement initiatives, improving efficiency, controls, and reporting capability. Identify chances to automate recurring work and to strengthen analytical tools. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 3–5 years of progressive experience in FP&A, cost accounting, or operations finance, preferably in a manufacturing or semiconductor environment. Solid understanding of cost of sales, inventory, absorption, and allocation methods, and how they flow through the P&L. Hands-on experience with month-end close, forecasting, and annual planning cycles. Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and building financial models. Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and with pulling and reconciling data from multiple sources. Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, executive-ready storylines. Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining variances and financial results to non-finance stakeholders. Business Optimization & Vendor Management Department The Business Optimization & Vendor Management team supports effective planning, financial visibility, operational discipline, and informed decision-making. The team partners with budget owners, business leaders, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders to maintain reliable planning information, monitor financial commitments, improve reporting, and strengthen processes that help the organization use its resources effectively. Position Overview The Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations supports budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities that help business leaders effectively manage approved budgets and financial commitments throughout the year. This role partners with budget owners and business leaders to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor spending, identify risks and opportunities, and keep assumptions aligned with current business needs. The analyst helps stakeholders avoid unexpected overspend while also identifying available funding and planned activities that may need action so approved resources are used effectively. The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with stakeholders. As the individual develops knowledge of the business and its planning processes, they will take an increasingly active role in recurring forecast discussions, budget reviews, and follow-up with assigned budget owners. Essential Job Functions Budget Planning & Forecast Management Support annual budget planning and recurring forecast cycles, including non-labor operating expense and capital expenditure planning. Maintain and update forecast workbooks, planning files, assumptions, and supporting documentation throughout the year. Work with budget owners to understand spending plans, project timing, contract obligations, purchase commitments, and changing business priorities. Help budget owners maintain realistic forecasts that reduce the risk of overspending and highlight opportunities to use approved funding before year-end. Track forecast changes, open actions, and decisions to ensure planning information remains current and explainable. Identify potential overages, unused funding, timing shifts, and other risks or opportunities, and raise them for timely discussion and action. Support capital planning, project cost tracking, and workforce or position planning activities as assigned. Budget Owner & Business Leader Partnership Build productive working relationships with budget owners and business leaders. Prepare for and participate in recurring budget and forecast review meetings. Ask thoughtful questions, clarify assumptions, document decisions, and follow up on required updates. Explain budget, forecast, actual, and committed-spend information in clear business terms. Provide budget owners with timely information that supports prioritization and spending decisions. With appropriate training and experience, independently lead routine forecast conversations and serve as a primary point of contact for assigned budget owners. Coordinate with Finance and other stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and keep planning data aligned. Financial Analysis & Reporting Analyze budget, forecast, actual, committed, and planned spend information. Perform variance analysis and identify the operational drivers behind changes in financial performance. Review spending trends and summarize relevant risks, opportunities, and recommended follow-up actions. Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and concise leadership summaries. Support ad hoc analysis, project financial reviews, business cases, and return-on-investment analysis as needed. Accounting Information Systems (ACCT 618): A study of the use of information systems in the accounting process, with an emphasis on computer systems and internal controls. Focus is on the analytical tools necessary to evaluate users' accounting information needs and to design, implement, and maintain an accounting information system to support business processes and cycles. Emphasis is on developing strategic cyber accounting initiatives to increase cybersecurity awareness inside organizations, with organizations in its supply chain, and with other stakeholders.
